name: Devourer of Souls
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
A succubus is a devourer of souls, destroyer of hearts, and dominator of minds. It knows nothing but evil.

This will be the creature you will learn to summon and control, but it cannot be brought into our world without a stimulus.

With a symbol of love as bait, it will surely answer your call. Then you can defeat it, and make it your tool.

It will be hard to find something of this nature, though. You should speak with Takar the Seer. You will find him in the Barrens of Kalimdor near Camp Taurajo.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Takar the Seer in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText: Was your crossing difficult, adventurer? You have come a long way to speak with me. But fear not, I know why Gakin has sent you, and he was wise to, for I can help you in your search.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 20, 3,865 XP in all.

quests.name: Gakin's Summons
quests.objectiveText: Report to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.

quests.name: Devourer of Souls
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Takar the Seer in the Barrens.

quests.name: Heartswood
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve the Heartswood from Ashenvale and bring it to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.

quests.name: The Binding
quests.objectiveText: Using the Heartswood Core, summon and subdue a succubus, then return the Heartswood Core to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Slaughtered Lamb.
